title: Charming East Nashville Home-10 min to downtown
description:
Welcome to our 1940s Ranch house in the heart of East Nashville, thoughtfully designed by my wife and I, a photographer/videographer couple who's lived in Nashville for over 20yrs.

3 beds, 2 baths, sleeps 6, with two living rooms to spread out in and a huge backyard for evenings outside or furry friends. 

Walk to East Nashville's best bars and restaurants, or head downtown in just 10 minutes. Design-forward, comfortable, and made to actually feel like home.

Parking available onsite as well.

The space
2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom on the main floor, 3rd bedroom, laundry and additional bathroom are located in the basement of the house via staircase.

HUGE fenced in backyard space for hangs and furry pets.
